cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(NeverDUnicornCRCCoexistence C CXX)
if(NOT MSVC OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "This diagnostic requires Windows x64 MSVC")
endif()
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${NEVERD_REPOSITORY}" _neverd_repository)
# Exercise the real repository wrappers with their normal source-root context.
set(_neverd_probe_source "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
set(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR "${_neverd_repository}")
include("${_neverd_repository}/cmake/NeverDUnicorn.cmake")
neverd_require_unicorn()
# The failure requires the repository's pinned static fallback, not a DLL.
set(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_ZLIB TRUE)
include("${_neverd_repository}/cmake/NeverDZlib.cmake")
set(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR "${_neverd_probe_source}")
if(NEVERD_CRC_BASELINE)
  foreach(_target unicorn-common arm-softmmu aarch64-softmmu)
    get_target_property(_options ${_target} COMPILE_OPTIONS)
    list(FILTER _options EXCLUDE REGEX "UnicornCRCNamespace[.]h")
    set_property(TARGET ${_target} PROPERTY COMPILE_OPTIONS "${_options}")
  endforeach()
endif()
add_executable(NeverDUnicornCRCCoexistence coexist.c)
target_link_libraries(NeverDUnicornCRCCoexistence PRIVATE unicorn-common ZLIB::ZLIB)

# Exercise the real header declarations across independently compiled units.
add_library(NeverDThunkHeaderProvider STATIC header_provider.cpp)
target_compile_features(NeverDThunkHeaderProvider PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(NeverDThunkHeaderProvider PUBLIC
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${_neverd_repository}/include")
add_executable(NeverDThunkHeaderABI header_consumer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(NeverDThunkHeaderABI PRIVATE NeverDThunkHeaderProvider)
if(NEVERD_CRC_BASELINE)
  file(READ "${_neverd_repository}/include/neverd/loader/LinkerThunk.h" _header)
  string(REPLACE "struct BinaryImage;" "class BinaryImage;" _original_header "${_header}")
  if(_original_header STREQUAL _header)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing the expected corrected forward declaration")
  endif()
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/original-header/neverd/loader")
  file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/original-header/neverd/loader/LinkerThunk.h"
    "${_original_header}")
  target_include_directories(NeverDThunkHeaderProvider BEFORE PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/original-header")
endif()
